Say each sound with its picture
Circle the first sound in apple, ball

Goat, hat, ink, jug, kite, leaf
Trace and say each sound

Moon, nose, orange, pen, queen, rope
Match letter to picture

Sun, tap, umbrella, van, water, box
Say all 26 sounds

a as in cat, e as in hen
Sort pictures by vowel

i as in sit, o as in pot, u as in cup
Pick the middle sound

at, an, am, in, on, up
Blend and read together

ban, can, fan, man, pan
Read the family ladder

bat, cat, fat, hat, mat
Make new words with letter cards

Read two letter words fast
Read our word wall
